text: A Psalm of David. 1 I will lift You high, my God, the King, and I will bless Your name forever and ever!
With every day, I will bless You, and I will praise Your name, forever and ever!
Great [is] YHWH and to be praised greatly, and of His greatness there is no searching out.
Generation to generation will commend Your works, and Your mighty acts they will declare.
The splendor of the glory of Your majesty, and words of Your wonders I will put forth.
And the strength of Your fearful acts they will speak, and Your greatness I will recount.
The memory of the abundance of Your goodness they will pour forth, and Your righteousness they will sing out.
Gracious and compassionate [is] YHWH, slow to anger and great in loving devotion.
Good [is] YHWH to all, and His mercies [are] upon all His works.
O YHWH, all Your works will give You thanks, and Your holy ones will bless You.
The glory of Your kingdom they will speak, and Your might they will declare,
to make known to the sons of man His mighty [deeds], and the glory of the majesty of His kingdom.

Your kingdom [is] a kingdom of all ages, and Your dominion [is] in every generation and generation.

Yahweh is faithful in all His words

and kind in all His actions.
YHWH is upholding all those falling, and raising up all those bent down low.
The eyes of all wait for You, and You give to them their food in its time.
You open Your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
Righteous [is] YHWH in all His ways, and kind in all His works.
Near [is] YHWH to all those calling on Him, to all who call on Him in truth.
He does the desire of those who fear Him, and their cry for help He hears, and He saves them.
YHWH is guarding all those loving Him, and all the wicked He will destroy.
My mouth will declare the praise of YHWH, and all flesh blesses the name of His holiness, forever and ever!
